name: B10-0083/2024 (Verts/ALE) – The democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on events in Georgia. It condemns new Georgian laws on "foreign influence" and "family values", and changes to election rules. It says these laws hurt civil society, independent media and political pluralism. It asks Georgia to act on the Venice Commission's recommendations, to hold free and fair elections on 26 October 2024, and to stop attacks on civil society. It also says the Council of the European Union may consider targeted sanctions.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Georgia to repeal or fix harmful laws.
- Affects Georgian civil society, media, opposition parties and voters.
- Next: EU assesses Georgia's progress; possible targeted sanctions discussed.
